title: SERVER-002: the bundled SHA-1 in indigo_server_tcp.c shifts int values into the sign bit, undefined behavior reported by UBSan on every WebSocket handshake
description:
sha1() promotes unsigned char bytes and the 0x80 padding constant to int and shifts them left by 24 (indigo_server_tcp.c sha1 block loop, tail loop and padding line), which is undefined behavior in C for values >= 0x80. UBSan reports 'left shift of 128 by 24 places cannot be represented in type int' during every handshake in test-server-websocket-sanitize, before and after the FND-000045 fix. Compilers currently produce the expected hash, so there is no observed functional failure. Next action: a scoped fix casting the shifted operands to unsigned, verified by the WebSocket sanitize test running without UBSan reports.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000046.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
